item.title: Google Unveils Multimodal AI System for Cuffless Hypertension Detection via Smartwatches
item.description:
Google has introduced AI-PPG-ACC-HTN, a multimodal AI system that passively detects signs of hypertension using ordinary consumer smartwatches without cuff calibration. The work, published in Nature, points to wearables moving from everyday monitoring toward disease screening.

原文标题：谷歌推多模态 AI 系统 用智能手表无袖带检测高血压

Why it matters：这是可穿戴设备与多模态 AI 结合进入临床级筛查的重要节点，且成果登上 Nature，值得关注。

item.title: Zhang Yimou Warns AI Short Videos, Now a Tens-of-Billions Sector, Challenge Cinema
item.description:
Speaking at a Golden Rooster film festival dialogue, director Zhang Yimou said AI-generated short videos have grown into a sector worth tens of billions of yuan and are pulling audiences away from theaters, calling it a major challenge with no clear answer for when AI surpasses humans in five to ten years. Regulators meanwhile signaled support for live-action micro-dramas while tightening rules on AI-generated ones.

原文标题：张艺谋谈 AI 冲击电影业：AI 短视频产值已达几百亿

Why it matters：行业权威人物对 AI 内容冲击传统影视的表态，反映产业格局变化，但缺乏具体数据来源与技术细节。

item.title: Google AI Detects Hypertension via Smartwatch Without a Cuff
item.description:
Google Research has introduced a neural network that flags signs of hypertension using only the pulse and motion sensors built into ordinary smartwatches, with no cuff calibration required. Trained via self-supervised learning on nearly 500,000 hours of sensor data, the model matched traditional cuffs in a 196-person study across five US sites. The method is now folded into Google Health's blood pressure trends feature but remains a research project, not a diagnosis.

原文标题：Google AI 用普通智能手表无袖带检测高血压

Why it matters：这是可穿戴传感器与自监督学习结合的重要健康 AI 进展，且已进入真实产品功能，值得关注。

item.title: Researchers Expose Undocumented Personal Knowledge Graph Daemons in macOS
item.description:
Security researchers reveal that every Mac since macOS 13 ships a pair of undocumented daemons that continuously build a personal knowledge graph covering user identity, relationships, communications and behavior, feeding Apple Intelligence personalization. They also released a tool letting users inspect their own graph.

原文标题：研究揭示 macOS 内置未公开个人知识图谱守护进程

Why it matters：该发现直接触及端侧个性化 AI 的数据边界与隐私透明度，对关注 Apple Intelligence 架构的读者具有实质参考价值。

item.description:

It originally sought $30 billion at a $1.4 trillion valuation but scaled back after an AI-sector selloff and is now courting wealthy individual investors via investment banks.

item.title: Apple Unveils HALO Humanoid Robot System With 91% Success Rate in Unmapped Environments
item.description:
Apple's research team published an arXiv paper detailing HALO, a humanoid robot autonomy stack that layers a VLM task orchestrator, a DiT motion generator, and a reinforcement-learning tracker, deployed on a Unitree G1 with an onboard Mac mini for inference. Across 360 single-task trials in six previously unmapped real environments, HALO averaged a 91% success rate, though long-horizon composite tasks fell to 70% and the hardest combination to 50%. The team also open-sourced the data generation, training, and deployment code.

原文标题：苹果发布人形机器人 HALO 系统 未建图环境平均成功率 91%

Why it matters：苹果首次系统披露人形机器人端到端自主控制方案并开源全链路代码，91% 未建图成功率与分层架构对具身智能研究者有直接参考价值。

item.title: Google Sued in US Over Gemini Conversations With 13-Year-Old on Self-Harm
item.description:
A North Carolina couple is suing Google, alleging their 13-year-old daughter held thousands of Gemini and AI Mode conversations about depression and suicide methods on a school-issued Chromebook without adequate warning to parents or schools. Google says it is reviewing the claims and this week made AI tools off by default for K-12 accounts, though schools that re-enable Search must accept bundled AI features—a move Fairplay calls forcing AI on schools.

原文标题：谷歌因 Gemini 涉未成年人轻生对话在美遭起诉

Why it matters：这是 AI 产品进入校园渠道后首例引发广泛关注的未成年人安全诉讼，直接触及 AI 部署边界与厂商责任。

item.title: Anthropic's Unreleased Model Helps Prove Quantum Computing Conjecture
item.description:
Physical Superintelligence (PSI) claims it used an unreleased Anthropic model to prove the Aaronson-Ambainis conjecture, open since 2008, in just three days, indicating that quantum speedups require special problem structure. If validated, it marks another landmark in AI-assisted mathematics, though the model, proof details and peer-review status remain undisclosed.

原文标题：Anthropic 未发布模型助证量子计算猜想

Why it matters：AI 辅助攻克长期数学猜想属高信号事件，但关键证据缺失，值得关注而非全盘采信。

item.title: Nous Research Post-Trains Qwen3.8-27B into Arete-27B
item.description:

The team argues that frontier labs share a homogeneous worldview that injects political bias into agents, and that open models let users reshape alignment to their own preferences.

item.title: Court Orders Insurer to Pay 46,000 Yuan After Firing Employee Over AI Tool Use
item.description:
A Beijing court ruled that an insurer unlawfully fired a legal staffer for uploading work data to a third-party AI platform, since internal rules never banned such tools, set no AI-specific compliance policy and offered no related training. The company must reinstate her and pay over 46,000 yuan in lost wages and bonus differences; an appeal was rejected. The case offers a rare judicial reference for corporate AI-use compliance and labor-law boundaries in China.

原文标题：员工用第三方 AI 办公遭解雇 法院判公司赔偿 4.6 万

Why it matters：首例进入公众视野的“员工用 AI 被开除”判决，直接划定企业 AI 合规制度缺位时的责任边界。

item.title: AFK AI Debuts Single-Router Multi-Worker Architecture for Always-On Agents

item.title: AGENTS.md Becomes New Attack Vector, Silently Hijacking AI Coding Agents
item.description:
Security firm Forever Security disclosed an attack chain in which a malicious webpage silently drops an AGENTS.md file into the user's Downloads folder; when a terminal-capable agent such as Claude Code or Codex is launched there, it treats the file as top-priority instructions, altering global config, disabling sandboxes, pulling malicious npm packages and exfiltrating API tokens. The root issue is that agents cannot distinguish developer conventions from attacker-injected instructions, invalidating the long-standing 'don't click the exe' security assumption.

原文标题：AGENTS.md 成新型攻击载体 静默下载即可劫持 AI 编程助手

Why it matters：首次系统性揭示 Agent 指令文件被武器化的完整攻击链，对所有使用终端型 AI 编程工具的开发者具有直接安全警示价值。

item.title: Jeff Dean Discusses RSI Limits and Unveils New Startup Discovery Loop
item.description:

He also disclosed that his new company Discovery Loop already runs about 20 automated improvement loops, aiming to lift domain-expert productivity 20-50x, and admitted he underestimated how deeply coding ability would boost general problem solving.

原文标题：Jeff Dean 谈 RSI 边界并披露新公司 Discovery Loop

Why it matters：Jeff Dean 首次系统披露新公司进展，并对当下最热的 RSI 叙事给出明确反共识判断，对判断 AI 研发自动化节奏有参考价值。

item.description:
